author: reek
body: Proves the AI player uses the opponent-hand belief model. The agent casts a Duress; the act of revealing records the opponent's remaining hand into the agent's Knowledge (the one legitimate window into hidden cards). The agent then consults that knowledge: if the revealed hand holds a castable threat (a Counterspell), it keeps holding up its own counter mana; if the revealed hand is only lands, it knows it is safe to tap out. With no reveal the agent knows nothing and defaults to holding up mana, exactly as before.
